scope: offline saved-state mechanism analysis; no receiver, scalar_joint, decoder or radio regeneration

definitions.pre_post: trace data_variance/gain_variance are POST update; pre values reconstructed from prior checkpoint/previous saved state
definitions.round_prior: r0 zero; r1 clip(previous round saved raw_check_extrinsic,-20,20)
definitions.n_vh_prediction: 1/(sv_current*xb_power+P/N) with gain-precision floor omitted; POINT reports latent posterior while propagated vh=0
definitions.scaling_limit: Only N=1024 observed; N-asymptotic scaling is not identifiable. Initial joint vh=1/P is a transient and not O(1/N) evidence.
definitions.scalar_subset: first eight frames per SNR for both arms and rounds, raw saved scalars only; vector-derived fields exist only for audit frame0
